blocks.text: Read the paragraph carefully: Must … Have to …
You must be careful when you drive a car. You must respect the traffic lights, the pedestrian lights and the transit signals. You must have a driver’s license. The car must be in good shape.

The traffic lights show you when you have to stop, or when you have to go ahead. Red means that you must stop. So the people and the children can cross the street. You must stop before the pedestrian crossing, so they can walk safely. Yellow means that you must be careful. Green means that you must go ahead.

blocks.text: When you drive you must know that a car is a means of transportation. It is not a race car, nor the streets of a city or even a highway are for racing. You have to watch out the gas tank, so you don’t run out of gas. The radiator, the engine and the other parts of the car must be in good shape. All the car lights must be working. The extra tire in the trunk must have air in case of a flat tire.

blocks.text: Pedestrians must also respect the transit signals and the traffic lights. They must cross a street only when the pedestrian green light appears with the word “WALK” and at the pedestrian line. They mustn’t cross a street in the middle of it, or when the traffic light is on green.
